The powered run reconstructs the direction through the frozen C2b code path with frozen inputs/seed/layer and uses the frozen E-0006 alpha/sigma parameters; auditing exact vector identity would require rerunning the reconstruction/model forward pass or adding future direction-vector persistence.

realized_mde.mde_note: mde_superiority: minimum |mean(d)| detectable at 80% power for the prereg Bonferroni test (two-sided CI at 98.33% excludes 0), using z_bonf=2.394 and z_80=0.842. mde_tost_max_equiv: max true |effect| ≤ this for which 90% TOST CI would have 80% power to declare equivalence within SESOI=±0.05; negative = study underpowered to rule out meaningful effects even if true effect=0.
